McKinsey's State of AI global survey would have been the strongest available instrument for the enterprise-adoption question; it backs no [n] marker in the report, and KPMG's Q2 2026 AI Pulse (stated method, n=204) plus Ramp's transaction data were used instead.

Paywalled and not fetched. Bloomberg was first to report the $65bn Anthropic run rate; the claim is cited instead to CNBC [9], which was fetched and quoted, and to TechCrunch [10], which attributes it to Bloomberg. The Bloomberg URL appears in sources.md only as a pointer and backs no [n] marker.

fetch_caveats: CNBC (source 9) returns HTTP 403 to a default fetcher user-agent and 200 to a browser user-agent; a citation gate using a plain fetcher will need the browser UA.

Three cited sources are PDFs (11, 13, 15): a grep-the-quote gate must run pdftotext -layout before matching, and the Exponential View report's two-column bullets wrap across lines in the raw extraction.

On ramp.com (18, 19) and techcrunch.com (10) the figures sit inside <span>/<a> tags, so quotes are contiguous in rendered text but not in raw HTML; a gate that strips tags before matching is required.
botcommits.dev (1) renders its headline numerals from JavaScript; the bare figures are cited to the data.json endpoint (2), which is static and greppable.
